mode.description: Operation mode: 'crypt' or 'decrypt'. (Note: cisco7crack uses CLI flags -c and -d; no config equivalent exists.)

plaintext.description: Plaintext string to encrypt (used only when mode is 'crypt').

ciphertext.description: Type-7 encrypted password to decrypt (used only when mode is 'decrypt').

index.description: Index (0-15) of the crypt variant to use with -#<n>. Ignored in decrypt mode.

all_variants.description: If true, display all crypt variants (equivalent to -a flag). Overrides index if true.
